canonical_project: DataVolt MODON AI-ready data center (Riyadh First Technology Park)
notes: DataVolt signed a February 2025 land lease with MODON (Saudi Authority for Industrial Cities) for a 55,000 sqm AI-ready data center in the First Technology Park, eastern Riyadh; planning/development phase under DataVolt's broader USD 5 billion KSA program. DataCenterMap separately lists 'DataVolt Riyadh East DC' (Khurais 522 St) as under construction with 16 MW phase 1 IT load targeted live Q1 2027; relationship between the two listings is not fully confirmed.
